title: OpenAI announces three big science discoveries and a new way to work with academics
slides: What if OpenAI just rewrote scientific discovery?
Three major findings announced at once
But the surprise is how they worked with academics
Researchers can now join a new collaboration model
Ask your institution about accessing it this week
thread_text:
1. OpenAI Just Rewrote Science?

A single announcement landed three major research findings at the same time. That pace doesn't look like a normal product update.

2. But Look Who's Involved

The surprise isn't the results, it's how the work was done with academics. This breaks the usual tech-lab playbook.

3. A New Collaboration Model

Researchers can now officially join this structure, which could reshape who gets credit and who controls the data.

4. Access Is the Real Test

Institutions need to sort out access this week. That timetable is faster than most university procurement teams can move.

5. Ask Your Institution Today

Contact your research office tomorrow and ask if they have access. If they don't know, that silence is your first answer.

instagram.caption:
Three scientific discoveries were announced at once — not from a university lab, but from OpenAI, and the results aren't even the strange part. 🔬

What's unusual is the setup: researchers can now formally join a new collaboration model with the company.

That means credit and data control may get renegotiated between tech labs and academia.

If you write or publish research content, the access terms of this model shape what you can cite, use, and verify. 📊

Ask your institution's research office this week whether they have access. If they don't know, that silence is your first answer. 🎓
